scope: Real Genkit Agent loops with local deterministic model and MCP HTTP fixtures

cases.assertions: Two SDK tool calls reuse one explicitly approved operation; one approval event, one actual MCP call and one success reservation
Two attempted SDK calls return denied; only the original approval is shown and no MCP call executes
Connection disabled after discovery returns unavailable before any tool call
Stored credentials changed after discovery invalidate the captured connection revision; no tool call executes
Approved destination A executes once; destination B interrupts with a different approval hash and is not executed

limitations: SDK span status OK may represent a denied or interrupted response; assertions distinguish these from an actual remote call
No paid model, image provider or real third-party account was used
CLI cleanup exited 1 because wmic.exe is absent; the flow result passed separately
Subsequent CIM inventory found no surviving Dart verifier or MCP fixture process
Natural-language user grant mapping, cross-entry network authorization and final deployment remain incomplete
